name: local-translate
title: LocalTranslate
description: Translate selected text between Swedish, English, and German using a local Unsloth model
author: jens

commands.name: swedish-to-english
commands.title: Swedish → English
commands.description: Translate selected Swedish text to English

commands.name: english-to-swedish
commands.title: English → Swedish
commands.description: Translate selected English text to Swedish

commands.name: swedish-to-german
commands.title: Swedish → German
commands.description: Translate selected Swedish text to German

commands.name: german-to-swedish
commands.title: German → Swedish
commands.description: Translate selected German text to Swedish

commands.name: german-to-english
commands.title: German → English
commands.description: Translate selected German text to English

commands.name: english-to-german
commands.title: English → German
commands.description: Translate selected English text to German

preferences.name: unslothApiKey
preferences.title: Unsloth API Key
preferences.description: API key created in Unsloth Desktop. It is sent only to the configured local server.

preferences.name: unslothModel
preferences.title: Unsloth Model
preferences.description: The loaded Unsloth model ID for translation

preferences.name: translationContext
preferences.title: Translation Context
preferences.description: Optional terminology and audience guidance for every translation
preferences.default: The user works at a technology company in Sweden. Prefer natural terminology commonly used in this context when appropriate.

preferences.name: inputMethod
preferences.title: Input Method
preferences.description: Where to read text from when a translation command is triggered
